module.purpose: Provides a reactive Map-compatible collection whose keys and values are backed by atoms, allowing reads and iteration to participate in tldraw state dependency tracking.
module.summary: This module implements a generic observable map abstraction. It stores an immutable key-to-atom index, uses individual atoms for values, and coordinates structural changes through transactions. Read methods distinguish reactive and non-capturing access, while deletion and iteration preserve Map-like behavior when entries change during traversal.
module.businessContext: Supports reactive application state keyed by domain identifiers. Failures can cause stale subscriptions, inconsistent collection updates, or incorrect UI and derived-state behavior.
